actions.text: Committee on Energy and Natural Resources. Ordered to be reported with an amendment in the nature of a substitute favorably.
Committee on Energy and Natural Resources Subcommittee on Public Lands, Forests, and Mining. Hearings held. With printed Hearing: S.Hrg. 119-237.
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources.

subcommittees.name: Public Lands, Forests, and Mining Subcommittee

dimensions.assessment: Affects public land users in Utah, county governments, the state of Utah, and the Bureau of Land Management.
dimensions.evidence: prohibits the use of funds by the Secretary of the Interior to finalize and implement certain travel management plans in the State of Utah.

dimensions.assessment: Halts specific federal travel management planning and route closures on public lands across designated areas in Utah until court cases are resolved.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary may not obligate or expend Federal funds-- (1) to finalize or implement... a new travel management plan

dimensions.assessment: Restricts the obligation and expenditure of federal funds for specific planning activities, but does not state aggregate budgetary savings or costs.
dimensions.evidence: prohibits the BLM from obligating or expending federal funds to (1) finalize or implement a new travel management plan

dimensions.assessment: Applies administrative restrictions on federal land management planning across specific geographic areas in Utah tied to ongoing litigation.
dimensions.evidence: covered travel management area means any of the following travel management areas in the State of Utah

dimensions.assessment: Remains in effect for an indeterminate duration spanning from enactment until the Secretary certifies that all specified R.S. 2477 court cases are fully adjudicated.
dimensions.evidence: The term 'applicable period' means the period that begins on the date of enactment of this Act and ends on the date on which the Secretary certifies... that each of the R.S. 2477 cases has been adjudicated.

missing_information: Timeline for when the R.S. 2477 court cases will conclude and when certification will occur.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill prohibits the Bureau of Land Management from expending federal funds to finalize or implement new travel management plans in specified Utah areas or four named travel plans until pending R.S. 2477 litigation cases are adjudicated.
